# McpServerConfig resource configuration reference

@include 'alerts/enterprise-alert.mdx'

This topic provides reference information for the `McpServerConfig` custom resource. An `McpServerConfig` defines the cluster-wide defaults for the MCP server sidecar that Consul injects into pods annotated with `consul.hashicorp.com/ai-role: mcp-server`.

Refer to [Kubernetes annotations and labels](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/annotation-label) for the pod annotations that override these defaults.

## Configuration model

The following list outlines the field hierarchy, data types, and requirements for the `McpServerConfig` resource. Click a property name to view additional details, including default values.

- [`apiVersion`](#apiversion): string | required | must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`
- [`kind`](#kind): string | required | must be set to `McpServerConfig`
- [`metadata`](#metadata): map | required
   - [`name`](#metadata-name): string | required
- [`spec`](#spec): map | required
   - [`enabled`](#spec-enabled): boolean | required | `false`
   - [`defaults`](#spec-defaults): map
      - [`interceptorPort`](#spec-defaults-interceptorport): integer | `21102`
      - [`transport`](#spec-defaults-transport): string | `streamable-http`
      - [`path`](#spec-defaults-path): string | `/mcp`
      - [`protocolVersion`](#spec-defaults-protocolversion): string | `2025-03-26`
      - [`resources`](#spec-defaults-resources): map
         - [`requests`](#spec-defaults-resources-requests): map
         - [`limits`](#spec-defaults-resources-limits): map

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, an `McpServerConfig` resource has the following form:

```yaml
apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: McpServerConfig
metadata:
  name: <name for this resource>
spec:
  enabled: <boolean>
  defaults:
    interceptorPort: <integer>
    transport: <streamable-http | sse | stdio>
    path: <string>
    protocolVersion: <string>
    resources:
      requests: <map>
      limits: <map>
```

## Specification

This section describes the fields you can configure in the `McpServerConfig` resource.

### `apiVersion`

Specifies the API version of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`.

### `kind`

Specifies the type of resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `McpServerConfig`.

### `metadata`

Map that contains the name for the resource. This resource is cluster scoped.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `metadata.name`

Specifies the name of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec`

Spec defines the desired state of McpServerConfig.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `spec.enabled`

Enabled controls whether the MCP server interceptor feature is active. When false the controller takes no action on annotated pods.

#### Values

- Default: `false`
- This field is required.
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.defaults`

Defaults contains the cluster-wide default settings applied to every mcp-annotated pod unless overridden at the pod annotation level.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.interceptorPort`

InterceptorPort is the TCP port the MCP server container listens on inside the pod. Must not conflict with the application port or the Envoy proxy port (20000).

#### Values

- Default: `21102`
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `1024`
- Maximum: `65535`

### `spec.defaults.transport`

Transport is the MCP wire transport to use.

#### Values

- Default: `streamable-http`
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `streamable-http`
  - `sse`
  - `stdio`

### `spec.defaults.path`

Path is the HTTP path the MCP server listens on.

#### Values

- Default: `/mcp`
- Data type: String

### `spec.defaults.protocolVersion`

ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version the server advertises.

#### Values

- Default: `2025-03-26`
- Data type: String

### `spec.defaults.resources`

Resources defines the CPU/memory requests and limits for the MCP server init-container injected into each annotated pod.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.resources.requests`

Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.resources.limits`

Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map
